rules.name: No dish on the same or next day
Curries, subzis and extras only when a rule asks for them
At most one Curry per meal
At most one Subzi per meal
Malabar Parotta: only on certain days
Paneer Butter Masala: only on certain days

Kerala Stew (Non-Veg): only on certain days
Gobi Manchurian (dry): only on certain days
Kootu Curry: served with these bases
Veg curries early in the week
